title: 观势决策看板
description: 按市场、资金、板块、个股、消息、预测往下看。红涨绿跌。

panels.title: 一、先看市场：指数平不平，赚钱效应在不在

options.content:
按这个顺序看：**市场 → 外盘 → 盘中路径 → 板块资金 → 个股 → 消息 → 自己的预测**。红涨绿跌。

指数几乎不动、但打板成功率和大涨家数很高，就是结构市。板块资金停在 9 月 30 日，个股行情到 10 月 9 日，不要当成同一天。空表在最底下覆盖表里行数为 0。

panels.title: 最近交易日

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(date)::text AS "日期" FROM stock_daily

panels.title: 上证收盘

targets.rawSql: SELECT close FROM index_daily WHERE code='sh000001' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 上证涨跌%

targets.rawSql: SELECT pct FROM index_daily WHERE code='sh000001' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 创业板涨跌%

targets.rawSql: SELECT pct FROM index_daily WHERE code='sz399006' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 上涨家数

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS v FROM stock_daily WHERE date=(SELECT max(date) FROM stock_daily) AND pct>0

panels.title: 下跌家数

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS v FROM stock_daily WHERE date=(SELECT max(date) FROM stock_daily) AND pct<0

panels.title: 打板成功率%

targets.rawSql: SELECT dbcgl FROM sentiment_daily ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 打板溢价%

targets.rawSql: SELECT dbyll FROM sentiment_daily ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 这一天合在一起看

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT max(date) AS d FROM stock_daily)
SELECT d.d::text AS "交易日",
  (SELECT round(pct::numeric, 2) FROM index_daily WHERE code='sh000001' AND date=d.d) AS "上证%",
  (SELECT round(pct::numeric, 2) FROM index_daily WHERE code='sh000300' AND date=d.d) AS "沪深300%",
  (SELECT round(pct::numeric, 2) FROM index_daily WHERE code='sz399006' AND date=d.d) AS "创业板%",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_daily WHERE date=d.d AND pct>0) AS "上涨",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_daily WHERE date=d.d AND pct<0) AS "下跌",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_daily WHERE date=d.d AND pct>=9.5) AS "涨幅≥9.5%",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stock_daily WHERE date=d.d AND pct<=-9.5) AS "跌幅≤-9.5%",
  (SELECT round(dbcgl::numeric, 2) FROM sentiment_daily WHERE date=d.d) AS "打板成功率%",
  (SELECT round(dbyll::numeric, 2) FROM sentiment_daily WHERE date=d.d) AS "打板溢价%",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM market_messages WHERE msg_ts::date = d.d) AS "当日快讯",
  (SELECT round((100.0 * sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 50) / NULLIF(max(tot),0))::numeric, 1)
     FROM (
       SELECT amount,
              row_number() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) rn,
              sum(amount) OVER () tot
       FROM stock_daily
       WHERE date = d.d AND amount > 0
     ) z) AS "前50成交额占比%"
FROM d

panels.title: 指数涨跌幅：谁在带方向

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS "time", 
CASE code
  WHEN 'sh000001' THEN '上证' WHEN 'sz399001' THEN '深成'
  WHEN 'sz399006' THEN '创业板' WHEN 'sh000300' THEN '沪深300'
  WHEN 'sh000016' THEN '上证50' WHEN 'sh000688' THEN '科创50'
  ELSE code END
 AS metric, pct AS value
FROM index_daily
WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND date <= $__timeTo()::date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 最近交易日：股票涨跌分布

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN pct >= 9.5 THEN '涨停附近 ≥9.5%'
         WHEN pct >= 3 THEN '强势 3~9.5%'
         WHEN pct > 0 THEN '上涨 0~3%'
         WHEN pct = 0 THEN '平盘'
         WHEN pct > -3 THEN '下跌 0~-3%'
         WHEN pct > -9.5 THEN '弱势 -3~-9.5%'
         ELSE '跌停附近 ≤-9.5%'
       END AS "区间",
       count(*)::int AS "家数"
FROM stock_daily
WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM stock_daily)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY min(pct) DESC

panels.title: 情绪：打板成功率与溢价

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS "time", '打板成功率' AS metric, dbcgl AS value
FROM sentiment_daily
WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND date <= $__timeTo()::date AND dbcgl IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT date, '打板溢价', dbyll
FROM sentiment_daily
WHERE date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND date <= $__timeTo()::date AND dbyll IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 隔夜外盘涨跌幅（美股、港股、商品）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS "time", 
CASE code
  WHEN 'SPX' THEN '标普' WHEN 'IXIC' THEN '纳指' WHEN 'DJI' THEN '道指'
  WHEN 'HSI' THEN '恒生' WHEN 'GC' THEN '黄金' WHEN 'CL' THEN '原油'
  WHEN 'SI' THEN '白银' ELSE code END
 AS metric, pct AS value
FROM global_daily
WHERE session = 'close'
  AND code IN ('SPX','IXIC','DJI','HSI','GC','CL','SI')
  AND date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND date <= $__timeTo()::date
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 二、盘中路径：分钟线看的是日内怎么走，不是收盘一个点
指数分钟收盘 · 库内最近一个交易日

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "time", 
CASE code
  WHEN 'sh000001' THEN '上证' WHEN 'sz399001' THEN '深成'
  WHEN 'sz399006' THEN '创业板' WHEN 'sh000300' THEN '沪深300'
  WHEN 'sh000016' THEN '上证50' WHEN 'sh000688' THEN '科创50'
  ELSE code END
 AS metric, close AS value
FROM index_minute
WHERE freq = '1m'
  AND ts >= (SELECT max(ts)::date FROM index_minute)
  AND ts < (SELECT max(ts)::date FROM index_minute) + INTERVAL '1 day'
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 分钟数据现在能看到什么

options.content:
**能看：** 六大指数的 1 分钟线，最近一根在 **2026-10-09 15:00**。上图永远画库里最后一个有分钟数据的交易日。

**观察池：** `stock_minute` 现在只有贵州茅台，周五 241 根，收到 15:00。

**外盘分钟：** `global_minute` 有 1 根标普期货盘前，时间 2026-10-10。纳指期货没有报价。

**还没有：** `plate_movement_intraday` 仍是 0 行。

panels.title: 三、资金和板块：钱在往哪边集中
概念板块涨幅前 12（最新交易日）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sector_name AS "板块", round(pct::numeric, 2) AS "涨跌幅%"
FROM sector_daily
WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM sector_daily)
ORDER BY pct DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 12

panels.title: 概念板块主力净流入前 12（亿元，同一天）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sector_name AS "板块", round((main_net_inflow/1e8)::numeric, 2) AS "净流入亿元"
FROM sector_daily
WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM sector_daily)
ORDER BY main_net_inflow DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 12

panels.title: 概念板块跌幅前 12

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sector_name AS "板块", round(pct::numeric, 2) AS "涨跌幅%"
FROM sector_daily
WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM sector_daily)
ORDER BY pct ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 12

panels.title: 资金各层有没有数（0 就是这层还没采进来）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT '概念板块资金' AS "层", count(*)::int AS "行数", max(date)::text AS "最新" FROM sector_daily
  UNION ALL SELECT '个股资金流', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM fund_flow_stock
  UNION ALL SELECT '板块资金流表', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM fund_flow_sector
  UNION ALL SELECT '北向', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM northbound_daily
  UNION ALL SELECT '两融全市场', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM margin_daily
  UNION ALL SELECT '两融个股', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM margin_stock
  UNION ALL SELECT '大宗', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM block_trade
  UNION ALL SELECT '龙虎榜', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM dragon_tiger
  UNION ALL SELECT '估值', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM valuation_daily
  UNION ALL SELECT '题材热度', count(*)::int, max(date)::text FROM theme_heat
) s ORDER BY "行数" DESC

panels.title: 四、落到个股：谁在涨，以及某个题材里面有什么
最近交易日领涨

targets.rawSql:
SELECT code AS "代码", name AS "名称", round(pct::numeric,2) AS "涨跌幅%",
       round(close::numeric,2) AS "收盘", round(amount::numeric,0) AS "成交额",
       round(turnover_rate::numeric,2) AS "换手%"
FROM stock_daily
WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM stock_daily)
ORDER BY pct DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 最近交易日领跌

targets.rawSql:
SELECT code AS "代码", name AS "名称", round(pct::numeric,2) AS "涨跌幅%",
       round(close::numeric,2) AS "收盘", round(amount::numeric,0) AS "成交额",
       round(turnover_rate::numeric,2) AS "换手%"
FROM stock_daily
WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM stock_daily)
ORDER BY pct ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 所选题材里的个股（右上角选题材，按最近交易日涨跌幅）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "代码","名称","涨跌幅%","收盘","成交额" FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.code)
    s.code AS "代码", s.name AS "名称",
    round(s.pct::numeric, 2) AS "涨跌幅%",
    round(s.close::numeric, 2) AS "收盘",
    round(s.amount::numeric, 0) AS "成交额"
  FROM stock_daily s
  JOIN stock_sector_map m ON m.code = s.code
  WHERE s.date = (SELECT max(date) FROM stock_daily)
    AND m.sector_name = '$theme'
    AND (m.effective_to IS NULL OR m.effective_to >= s.date)
  ORDER BY s.code
) x
ORDER BY "涨跌幅%" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 40

panels.title: 竞价强弱（只要正式竞价快照，去掉新股异常值）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT code AS "代码", name AS "名称", round(jjzf::numeric, 2) AS "竞价涨幅%",
       ssbk AS "板块", ztyy AS "原因"
FROM bidding_list
WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM bidding_list)
  AND quotations_type = 9
ORDER BY jjzf DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 五、消息和催化：市场在说什么，系统怎么记的
快讯（接近实时，始终取最新 40 条）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(msg_ts, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "时间",
       left(title, 80) AS "标题",
       source AS "来源"
FROM market_messages
ORDER BY msg_ts DESC
LIMIT 40

panels.title: 雷达事件：最近一个有数据的交易日（仍停在 2026-09-30）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_type AS "事件", count(*)::int AS "次数"
FROM radar_event
WHERE ts::date = (SELECT max(ts)::date FROM radar_event)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 12

panels.title: 电报最近 15 条

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(pub_ts, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "时间",
       left(title, 80) AS "标题", media AS "媒体"
FROM news_telegraph
ORDER BY pub_ts DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: 催化冲击最近 15 条

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::text AS "日期", impact_level AS "级别", lifecycle_stage AS "阶段",
       verified_result AS "验证", left(message_summary, 70) AS "消息"
FROM catalyst_impact
ORDER BY message_time DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 15

panels.title: 六、对照自己的判断：预测、反思、认知
预测结果分布

targets.rawSql:
SELECT result AS "结果", count(*)::int AS "条数"
FROM prediction
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: 最近预测

targets.rawSql:
SELECT prediction_id AS "编号", to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "创建", category AS "类别",
       confidence_pct AS "置信", horizon AS "窗口", result AS "结果",
       left(statement, 72) AS "判断"
FROM prediction
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: 反思记录

targets.rawSql:
SELECT decision_id AS "决策", quadrant AS "四象限", error_stage AS "归因",
       action_status AS "行动", left(lesson_text, 60) AS "教训"
FROM reflection
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 认知库：类型 × 状态

targets.rawSql:
SELECT type || ' / ' || status AS "类型", count(*)::int AS "条数"
FROM cognition
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 12

panels.title: 基率（同类情形的历史命中率）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT regime AS "相态", category AS "类别", horizon AS "窗口",
       window_end AS "截止", n_samples AS "样本",
       round(hit_rate::numeric, 3) AS "命中率"
FROM base_rate
ORDER BY window_end DESC, n_samples DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: 最近 24 小时采集作业

targets.rawSql:
SELECT job AS "作业", status AS "状态", count(*)::int AS "次数",
       to_char(max(ts), 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "最近"
FROM ingest_log
WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY max(ts) DESC
